messages:
samir: Morning — nightly vuln-scan failing on gitlab-runner-4 for repos with large node_modules. Trivy starts then hangs on 'scanning layer' and the runner OOMs.

samir: Log excerpt:
```
trivy: Scanning layer: 5/12
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
goroutine 92 [running]:
...
```

security-bot: Scan failure detected for org/foo-service (job id 4321). Reason: exit code 137. See CI job link: <https://gitlab/redwood/ci/4321>

lisa-security: :eyes: Any recent infra changes? KMS key rotation or cache bucket perms?

jordan: We rotated the KMS wrapping key for the vuln-cache bucket last night. I saw some AccessDenied in S3 logs around 02:12 UTC. Error snippet:
```
AccessDenied: Access Denied
status code: 403, request id: ...
```
That could cause Trivy to repeatedly retry fetching layers and then run OOM.

priya: Agreed. If Trivy keeps hitting retries it will balloon memory. Can we skip remote cache for a quick test? alex can trigger a non-cache run?

alex: Kicking off a manual run without cache now: `CI_VULN_CACHE=false ./ci/run-trivy.sh org/foo-service` — will report back.

samir: Also noticed a bunch of low-severity noise from dev-only deps (eg package `debug` flagged with CVE-2022-XXXX). We should update suppression rules rather than whitelisting globally.

priya: Proposed suppression rule (expires) to add to trivy-suppression.json:
```
{
  "rule_name": "ignore-dev-only-debug",
  "match": { "package": "debug", "path_regex": ".*node_modules/.*dev-deps.*" },
  "reason": "dev-only, not included in production bundle",
  "expires": "2025-01-01"
}
```

lisa-security: Fine with a short-lived suppression. Ensure policy doc lists justification + CVE ids.

jordan: After KMS fix I'll clear the vuln-cache, re-run nightly full scan, and reopen any suppressed items for review if they persist. Also GHAS webhook rate limiting is happening — batching GHAS uploads to once per 10 mins will reduce the burst.

ops-bot: Scheduled job `vuln-scan-full` re-run queued at 2025-03-14T03:15:00Z by @ops-bot

samir: Prioritization: CVE-2024-5678 (RCE in dep X) = P0, CVE-2023-2345 (info leak) = P2. Patch plan: patch dep X, run build, run integration tests, then deploy canary.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll take the canary rollout after tests pass.

lisa-security: Documenting decisions in security runbook. Thanks everyone.
